messages.content: 我想訂製一尊馬的青銅雕塑。有哪些材料選擇？

function.name: painting_create_custom
function.description: Order a custom painting with your preferred color. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

subject.description: The subject of the painting, e.g. horse

color.description: Preferred main color for the painting.

size.description: The desired size for the painting in inches. This parameter is optional. Default 12

function.name: sculpture_create_custom
function.description: Order a custom sculpture with your preferred material. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

item.description: The subject of the sculpture, e.g. horse

size.description: The desired size for the sculpture in inches. This parameter is optional. Default 12

message.content:
以下是可供訂製馬形雕塑的材質選項（您可以在下單時指定）：

| 材質 | 特點 |
|------|------|
| **Bronze** (青銅) | 耐久、表面光澤，適合戶外或室內展示 |
| **Marble** (大理石) | 高雅、細膩紋理，適合正式場合 |
| **Terracotta** (陶土) | 自然色調、較輕量，適合室內裝飾 |
| **Wood** (木材) | 溫暖感覺，可做多種風格 |
| **Stone** (石材) | 堅固、自然紋路，適合大型作品 |

> **備註**：若不指定尺寸，預設為 12 英吋（約 30 公分）。如果您已決定要訂購，我可以協助您完成下單流程。

請告訴我您是否需要進一步的協助，例如確認尺寸、顏色或其他細節！
message.reasoning: The user says: "I want to order a bronze sculpture of a horse. What materials are available?" They ask about materials. We need to respond with the options. According to the tool, the sculpture_create_custom function has material options: Bronze, Marble, Terracotta, Wood, Stone. So we should list those. Also mention default size if not specified. Then ask if they want to proceed. Probably we can also offer to place an order. But the user didn't explicitly request ordering; they just asked what materials are available. So we answer with the list and maybe ask if they'd like to place an order.
